scientific_integrity: The included script performs reproducible exact algebra and finite enumeration; full infinite graph shortcut and stochastic limits are justified by written proof, not inferred from enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The new exact formulas concern the second power of the integer line with independent binary edge weights 1 and 2 at fixed interior probability; general LLN/CLT theory and finite-state Poisson-equation methods are prior art. No independent check of global historical priority is claimed. The related 2011 ladder article was available only in abstract, but studies a non-isomorphic graph.
title: Rational passage constants and a sharp monotone-geodesic boundary for binary two-step first-passage percolation
